cases.title: battery external grid injection
cases.contract: port battery.grid carrier electricity kind active_power unit MW sign INJECTION; guarantee bounds -3..4 MW; ledger delta MWh; source SRC_B; owner OWNER_TBD

cases.title: individual EV departure guarantee
cases.contract: port fleet.grid carrier electricity kind active_power unit MW sign CONSUMPTION; guarantee forall vehicles departure_energy; source SRC_EV
cases.variants: fleet service quantifier forall vehicle exists feasible dispatch
cases.negative_mutation: aggregate MWh okay but vehicle deadline missed

cases.title: electrolyser electricity/H2 interfaces
cases.contract: port el.grid carrier electricity kind active_power unit MW sign CONSUMPTION; port el.h2 carrier hydrogen kind mass_flow unit kg/h; source SRC_EL
cases.variants: two typed ports and approved heating_value_basis

cases.title: H2 storage mass conservation
cases.contract: port h2store.mass carrier hydrogen kind mass_flow unit kg/h; guarantee conservation of kg inventory; source SRC_HS
cases.variants: mass ledger under explicit leakage basis

cases.title: DC electric KCL and KVL
cases.contract: referent branch role physical_branch; guarantee KCL_AND_KVL under DC assumptions; source SRC_GRID
cases.variants: angle or PTDF implementation allowed with required KVL trace

cases.title: expansion admissibility
cases.contract: guarantee discrete modules when source requires; disclose continuum approximation; source SRC_INV
cases.variants: module count integer 0 or 1 on approved profile

cases.title: stage information-set condition
cases.contract: guarantee stage1 decision equal across unrevealed scenarios; source SRC_SCEN

cases.title: cost KPI basis and weights
cases.contract: observe total_system_cost kind currency unit EUR basis real_2025 discount explicit; source SRC_KPI
cases.variants: solver objective or postprocess ledger same contract KPI
cases.negative_mutation: omit temporal weight or double-count CAPEX

cases.title: CBA counterfactual / unknown method owner
cases.contract: frame baseline BASE and project P with shared exogenous snapshot; owner OWNER_TBD; source SRC_CBA
cases.variants: integrated CBA or external postprocess, no N2E authority claim
cases.negative_mutation: counterfactual data drift or owner approval invented

cases.title: multi-model variation + evidence
cases.contract: compare two model implementations by shared KPI + sources + variation, evidence NOT_EXECUTED; source SRC_MULTI
cases.variants: two independent model internals with same obligations and disclosed variation
cases.negative_mutation: declare E4 from identical cost; evidence NOT_EXECUTED->PASS
